create_kernel_density_model: create a kernel density estimation model to learn a generative model from digit data
run_grid_search_bandwidth: run grid search cross-validation to optimize the KDE bandwidth parameter
sample_from_kde_model: sample new digit points from a trained kernel density estimation model
reduce_dimensions_with_pca: reduce 64-dimensional digit data to a lower dimension using PCA
plot_real_and_resampled_digits: plot real digits and resampled digits from the KDE model in a grid layout
